## Checklist

- [ ] This PR has a single clear responsibility.
- [ ] The change respects the documented API and frontend contracts.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, credentials, private keys, certificates, or real `.env` values are committed.
- [ ] No database schema changes are introduced outside the corresponding `-db` repository.
- [ ] The portal does not provide its own `HttpClient`.
- [ ] The portal does not manage authentication tokens or session state.
- [ ] The portal does not contain gateway hosts or absolute API URLs.
- [ ] `package-lock.json` remains versioned when dependencies change.
- [ ] The PR remains within the repository change-size limit.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] `.github/CODEOWNERS` was not modified.
